[[Guangzhou Matsunichi F.C.|Guangzhou Songri]] | continentalcup1 = [[1997–98 Asian Club Championship|Asian Club Championship]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers = [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Wanda]] | league topscorer = [[Su Maozhen]] (13 goals) | matches = 132 | total goals = 292 | average attendance = 24,266 | prevseason = [[1995 Chinese Jia-A League|1995]] | nextseason = [[1997 Chinese Jia-A League|1997]] }} The '''1996 [[Chinese Jia-A League]] season''' (known as '''[[Marlboro]] Jia-A League''' for sponsorship reasons) was the third season of professional association football and the 35th top-tier overall league season held in China. Starting on April 14 and ending on October 27, [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Wanda]] won their second championship title. ==Promotion and relegation== '''Teams promoted from [[1995 Chinese Jia-B League]]''' *[[Shenzhen F.C.|Shenzhen Feiyada]] *[[Guangzhou Matsunichi F.C.|Guangzhou Songri]] '''Teams relegated from [[1995 Chinese Jia-A League]]''' *[[Qingdao Hainiu F.C.|Qingdao Hainiu]] *[[Liaoning F.C.|Liaoning]] ==Overview== It was contested by 12 teams, and [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Wanda]] won the championship. ==Personnel== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size:95%" |- !Team !Manager |- | [[Bayi Football Team|August 1st]] | |- | [[Beijing Guoan F.C.|Beijing Guoan]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Jin Zhiyang]] |- | [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Wanda]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Chi Shangbin]] |- | [[Guangdong Winnerway F.C.|Guangdong Hongyuan]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[He Jinlun]] |- | [[Guangzhou F.C.|Guangzhou Apollo]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Xian Dixiong]] |- | [[Guangzhou Matsunichi F.C.|Guangzhou Songri]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Zhang Honggen]] |- | [[Shandong Taishan F.C.|Jinan Taishan General]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Yin Tiesheng]] |- | [[Shanghai Shenhua F.C.|Shanghai Shenhua]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Xu Genbao]] |- | [[Shenzhen F.C.|Shenzhen Feiyada]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Liu Jianjiang]] |- | [[Sichuan First City F.C.|Sichuan Quanxing]] | |- | [[Tianjin Jinmen Tiger F.C.|Tianjin Samsung]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Zuo Shusheng]] |- | [[Yanbian Funde F.C.|Yanbian Hyundai]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Li Huen]] |} == Foreign players == As a military-owned team, August 1st were not allowed to sign any foreign players. {| class="wikitable" !
